issues.title: [P5-04] Playback engine and the single song-time clock
issues.body:
**Phase:** P5 Tab View and Synced Playback · **Plan key:** `P5-04` · **Priority:** P0
**Parent:** #29

### Context
Everything synced reads song time from the audio player. A separate timer would drift. This issue builds the one clock the rest of P5 uses.

### SDD traceability
- RC-18 one clock for sync
- DD-14 the audio player is the only clock
- US-13 pitch-preserved speed
- Source: [SDD v0.3](https://github.com/etabor3096/Amphion/blob/main/docs/SDD.pdf) · Implementation Plan Section 3, phase P5

### Scope
- `PlaybackEngine` on AVAudioEngine with AVAudioUnitTimePitch, playing the local file for the song.
- `currentSongTime()` read from the player's render time, in seconds.
- Play, pause, seek; a display-refresh hook (CADisplayLink or TimelineView) that reads the clock each frame.
- Audio session set up for playback.

### Out of scope and guardrails
- No other timer may drive synced UI, ever.
- No highlight UI yet (P5-05).
- Read `AGENTS.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md` and `POLICY.md` first. If something here conflicts with the SDD, stop and ask in a comment instead of guessing.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Song time after pause, seek and resume matches the audio within 10 ms in a test.
- [ ] There is no Timer or counter that advances song time anywhere in the app.
- [ ] Unit tests cover seek and pause.

### Design references
- Demo source: [`src/playback/clock.ts`](https://github.com/etabor3096/Amphion/blob/a00aed13d46751ae5887d147293059b01b82afc1/src/playback/clock.ts) (behavior reference, do not port line for line)

If something here conflicts with the SDD, stop and ask in a comment instead of guessing. ### Acceptance criteria - [ ] Display name persists after relaunch. - [ ] Password and email changes need the current password. - [ ] Provider users see no password option. ### Design references - Demo screen `09-account`: - Demo screen `06-settings`: ### Dependencies - Blocked by {{P2-03}} ### Verification - Test with an email account and an Apple account. - PR into `dev` with CI green; Elijah reviews before promotion to `staging`.

issues.title: [P7-07] Delete account and all of the user's data
issues.body: **Phase:** P7 Library and Account Management · **Plan key:** `P7-07` · **Priority:** P0 **Parent:** #34 ### Context Apple requires in-app account deletion. It must remove everything the user owns. ### SDD traceability - RC-15 account deletion - US-15 delete account - RC-17 artwork deleted with the account - Source: [SDD v0.3](https://github.com/etabor3096/Amphion/blob/main/docs/SDD.pdf) · Implementation Plan Section 3, phase P7 ### Scope - Delete account in Settings > Account with typed confirmation and recent sign-in. - A server function on user deletion removes all Firestore records and Storage artwork for that uid. - Local audio files are removed and the user is signed out. ### Out of scope and guardrails - Deletion cannot be undone; say so in the confirmation. - Read `AGENTS.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md` and `POLICY.md` first. If something here conflicts with the SDD, stop and ask in a comment instead of guessing. ### Acceptance criteria - [ ] After deletion the old credentials cannot sign in. - [ ] No Firestore or Storage data remains for that uid. - [ ] Local songs are gone from the device. ### Design references - Demo screen `09-account`: ### Dependencies - Blocked by {{P7-06}} - Blocked by {{P7-05}} - Blocked by #34 ### Verification - Emulator test plus a manual run. - PR into `dev` with CI green; Elijah reviews before promotion to `staging`.
